Moreover, current node 1.3 establishes that the root antecedent lacks the four corner maps' required bijectivity, so the merge lemma cannot be applied and node 1.3 establishes no assembled map v and no extended isomorphism; it also supplies neither missing algebra type. Hence neither the merge step nor the conditional unit-control bridge can be discharged from the current root. A valid repair must add the two algebra-typing hypotheses and the four maps' bijectivity, or restrict the datum to the explicitly typed Stage-3 output furnished under all hypotheses of lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum.
